# sophosfirewall_ipv4_group (Resource)

Manages an IPv4 address group (*Objects > Hosts and services > IP host group*). Groups can be referenced from firewall and NAT rules wherever a single host can.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sophosfirewall_ipv4_address" "web1" {
  name       = "web-01"
  ip_address = "203.0.113.10"
}

resource "sophosfirewall_ipv4_address" "web2" {
  name       = "web-02"
  ip_address = "203.0.113.11"
}

resource "sophosfirewall_ipv4_group" "web" {
  name        = "web-servers"
  description = "Public web servers"
  addresses = [
    sophosfirewall_ipv4_address.web1.name,
    sophosfirewall_ipv4_address.web2.name,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the IPv4 address group.

### Optional

- `addresses` (Set of String) Names of the IPv4 address objects (`sophosfirewall_ipv4_address`) in the group. Membership is unordered. Omit it for an empty group.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name or UUID.
terraform import sophosfirewall_ipv4_group.example <name-or-uuid>
```
